Arian Kabashi is a professional footballer born on June 18, 1996, in Switzerland. He plays as a central midfielder or defensive midfielder. 

Kabashi began his youth career at FC Zürich before moving to Grasshopper Club Zürich. He made his professional debut for FC Zürich in the Swiss Super League in 2014. 

In 2016, Kabashi moved to England to join the youth academy of Premier League club, Liverpool. He spent two years with the Liverpool U23 team, competing in Premier League 2 and the EFL Trophy.

After his time at Liverpool, Kabashi moved to Germany to play for VfL Bochum in the 2. Bundesliga. He also had loan spells at SV Rödinghausen and SV Wehen Wiesbaden.

Kabashi has represented Switzerland at various youth levels, including the U17, U18, and U20 national teams. He has shown potential as a talented midfielder with good passing ability and defensive skills.
